bio: Giuseppe was born on 30 January 1678 (the tree says 1676), son of Ottavio Putero and Vittoria (A)ragona ([R4-S1]). He married Beatrice Manfrida on 28 August 1709 ([R4-S2]) and was buried on 13 November 1748 ([R4-S3]).
